title: MxJobsWMS portfolio risk report
description: Returned by POST /risk of portfolio-cpp. Request: {assets, weights (asset → weight), covariance, expectedReturns?, confidence? (default 0.95), horizonDays? (default 1), portfolioValue? (default 1)}.

valueAtRisk.description: Parametric (normal) VaR over horizonDays at confidence, in portfolioValue units (positive = loss).

riskContributions.description: Asset → share of portfolio variance (sums to 1).

diversificationRatio.description: Σ wᵢσᵢ / σₚ (≥ 1; higher = more diversified).

concentration.description: Herfindahl index of the weights, Σ wᵢ².
